description: One course's concept catalog: the human-readable labels the Mastery connector pushes so avatar's dashboard can name the scores it renders. Under Model Y the catalog tables (mastery_courses.title, mastery_sections, mastery_concepts) stay user-facing in avatar, but the connector's extraction becomes their only writer, through this push. Course-scoped, not per-student: it carries no subject_id, and it is pushed on (re)extraction rather than on every student result, so the catalog is not repeated on every score push. provenance is the course locator, stable across re-pushes; version is a digest of the catalog content, so an unchanged re-extraction dedupes and a changed one is a new version the receiving side upserts onto the same course. observed_at is the connector-side timestamp when extraction finished. The concept_index and section_index here share the namespace the RESULT record's scores are keyed by, so a re-extraction that renumbers them must republish the catalog and the affected results together; the receiving side (ROL-16821) applies them consistently.

course_id.description: The external course identifier, stable across both databases and the resolution key together with the contract's tenant. Not either database's internal UUID.

title.description: The course title the dashboard shows, from the LMS course content name or the SCORM registration. Optional: the source may not have set one.

sections.description: The course's sections, the dashboard's module grouping. Ordered. Each section_index is unique within the course; draft-07 cannot express that, so the producer must guarantee it. May be empty for a course with no section structure.

section_index.description: The section's 0-based index within the course; concepts reference it.

title.description: The section title the dashboard shows as the module name.

concepts.description: The course's concepts, the labels joined onto per-student scores. Each concept_index is unique within the course and is the same index the RESULT record scores; draft-07 cannot express that, so the producer must guarantee it.

concept_index.description: The concept's 0-based index within the course; the RESULT record scores this same index.

name.description: The concept name the dashboard shows.

description.description: The concept description shown on the concept-detail and aggregate reads. Optional.

section_index.description: The section this concept belongs to, referencing sections[].section_index. Optional: a concept may belong to no section. When set it must reference a section present in this payload; draft-07 cannot express that, so the producer must guarantee it; a dangling reference would otherwise drop the concept's module grouping on the dashboard.
